text.p: The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angry Yeltsin sacks Lebed: Ousted rival promises to seek power, 'but only using constitutional means'.
- Tax relief at heart of Reform Party platform: Reform leader Preston Manning vows to cut government.
- Civil servants disrupt Paris: French support national walk-out.
- High-tech civic votes possible in Ontario: Municipalities to get more automony.
- Children of single mothers show increased problems: Statistics Canada study finds more behaviour trouble, school failure.
- Debt rigging worries Ottawa: Large brokers' ability to influence interest rates on T-bills concerns federal authorities.
- Tax change plan riles British Columbia immigrants: Wealthy Asians threaten to leave if forced to reveal large offshore assets.
- RBC Dominion hired to block Altamira bid: Shareholder warns it'll 'drop a nuclear bomb' on takeover bid.
- Telemarketing scams targeted by Ottawa: Changes to make it easier to shut illegal shops.
- Bre-X confronts foe as pressure for deal mounts.
